title: Second order of each customer
statementMd:
For customers with at least two orders (any status), show the id and date of their second order.

Expected columns: `customer_id`, `order_id`, `order_date`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT customer_id, id, order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, id) AS rn FROM orders) SELECT customer_id, id AS order_id, order_date FROM r WHERE rn = 2;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
